core_obligations: Record flatness of the colimit over the base (proof lines 10466-10467).
Let the residue field be extended by a finite purely inseparable extension and rewrite the base changed fibre as a colimit of smooth algebras over that field (proof lines 10468-10476).
Use regularity of local rings of smooth algebras over a field and stability of regularity under colimits to conclude (proof lines 10477-10483).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the fibre as a colimit of smooth algebras (proof lines 10468-10476).
Regularity of the local rings (proof lines 10477-10483).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a filtered colimit of smooth algebras over a ring is regular as a ring map provided its fibres are Noetherian. The proof verifies the two defining properties of regularity: flatness of the colimit follows from flatness of smooth algebras together with stability of flatness under filtered colimits, and for the fibres the author extends the residue field by a finite purely inseparable extension, rewrites the base changed fibre as a filtered colimit of smooth algebras over that field, and concludes that its local rings are regular because local rings of smooth algebras over a field are regular and regularity is preserved by filtered colimits.
